content.question: Match each main class of machine learning tasks with its description.

answer.Regression: Predicts a continuous numeric value, such as a price or temperature, from input features.
answer.Classification: Predicts a discrete class label, such as spam or not spam, using labeled examples.
answer.Association: Finds rules describing items that occur together, such as 'customers who buy bread also buy butter'.
answer.Clusterization: Groups unlabeled objects so that items in the same group are more similar to each other than to the rest.
